defaultPriceUsdPerMChars.source: Public translation API rates 2017 (Google Cloud Translation: $20 per million characters)

seedCustomers.source: Game-design estimate: first customers that sign up on launch day

demandMCharsPerCustomerH.source: Game-design estimate: 50,000 characters per customer per hour (about 1.2 M characters per customer per day)

capacityMCharsPerP100eqH.source: Game-design estimate: approx. NMT translation throughput on one P100-class GPU in 2017, in million characters per hour

baseLatencyMs.source: Game-design estimate: latency of an unsaturated 2017 NMT translation request

maxLatencyMs.source: Game-design choice: latency cap when the service is saturated or has no capacity

qualityBase.source: Game-design estimate: perceived quality of the first (paper replication) model, 0..1

qualityModelV2.source: Game-design estimate: perceived quality once the larger translation v2 model ships, 0..1

weeklyGrowth.source: Game-design estimate: weekly customer growth at full satisfaction at the reference price — ajuste de diseño (T15): 0.03→0.1, at 0.03 the customer base grew under 2 %/week with v2 and the seed round (300 customers) never came within 120 weeks; 10 %/week at full satisfaction gives 6 %/week at v2 quality (0.8), within the 5–7 %/week Paul Graham calls good for a startup ('Startup = Growth', 2012), so 20→300 customers takes about 46 weeks

elasticityExponent.source: Game-design estimate: price elasticity of customer growth (ruling R22): with growing demand (satisfaction > 0.5) the factor is (reference price / price)^exponent, with shrinking demand (price / reference price)^exponent, so a high price speeds up losses and a low price slows them

maxElasticityFactor.source: Game-design estimate: cap on (reference price / price)^exponent so very cheap prices cannot explode growth — ajuste de diseño (T15): 4→2, with the faster base growth a ×4 cap let a rock-bottom price reach 300 customers in about 13 weeks; ×2 keeps the fastest price-cutting route above 20 weeks

maxWeeklyGrowthAbs.source: Game-design estimate: weekly customer growth/decline is clamped to +/-50 % so customers never go negative or explode

minPriceUsdPerMChars.source: Game-design estimate: lowest legal price per million characters

maxPriceUsdPerMChars.source: Game-design estimate: highest legal price per million characters

workP100h.source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762 §5.2: base model, 8 P100 x 12 h = 96 P100-hours
Game-design estimate: a larger production translation model, about 4x the base paper model

checkpointEveryH.source: Game-design choice: a checkpoint every 4 hours

researchContractFactor.source: Game-design choice: an active research contract takes half of the lab's own GPU time

start.source: Didactic curve shape, not paper data: loss span above the floor at 0 % progress

exponent.source: Didactic curve shape, not paper data: how fast the loss falls

floor.source: Didactic curve shape, not paper data: loss at 100 % progress

everyWeeks.source: Game-design choice: consulting offers arrive every 4 weeks

maxOffers.source: Game-design choice: 0 to 2 offers per round

usdMin.source: Game-design choice: smallest consulting gig for a 2017 AI lab

usdMax.source: Game-design choice: largest consulting gig for a 2017 AI lab

usdStep.source: Game-design choice: gig values are rounded to this step

weeksMin.source: Game-design choice: shortest gig, in weeks

weeksMax.source: Game-design choice: longest gig, in weeks

minReputation.source: Game-design choice: reputation needed before a compute grant is offered

p100eq.source: Game-design choice: 500 cloud V100 hours modelled as 2.5 P100-equivalents of virtual GPU

hours.source: Game-design choice: cloud V100 hours granted

weeks.source: Game-design choice: weeks the grant stays open once accepted

bankruptcyNegativeWeeks.source: Game-design choice: consecutive weekly settlements ending with negative cash before bankruptcy

replicatePaper.source: Game-design choice: reputation reward for replicating the paper

translationV2.source: Game-design choice: reputation reward for the translation v2 model — ajuste de diseño (T15): 10→15, ruling R24: replicate (15) + v2 must reach seedMinReputation (30), otherwise the seed round is unreachable
